name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next UD-IQ3_XXS — own runtime, one GPU

library.summary: One B70: approved 37.595605 tok/s record with a 128-token cap. Separate full-512 lab replay: writing 31.51–31.78 tok/s and reading 32.59–32.75 tok/s. Updated source-build and experimental streaming guidance; full-output quality and portable admission remain pending.
library.benchmark_status: Full-512 profile: 31.510–31.782 tok/s, 512-input reading 32.595–32.752 tok/s; oracle checks first 128 only, longer outputs repeat-exact. Separate approved 128-token record: 37.595605 tok/s (packet196 diet/max23, October 23), superseding 36.602512. Streaming/checkpoint correctness is separately qualified on the P198/P201 identity, with no new speed claim.

hardware.note: 128 GiB lab host; 98990252032 bytes host memory available required; whole-host isolation, one user, native lab replay.

runtime.engine: Own Xe runtime (packet58aj / packet165c); arithmetic iq3-p49-split32-v1
runtime.compiler: Intel oneAPI compiler 2026.0; clean-source CPU compile and link passed; one-card portable rebuild from the published source archive device-qualified on 2026-10-22: two fresh loads at 31.83 / 31.81 tok/s, every output token identical to the sealed packet165 line (the binary hash differs); measured rows and commands still use the sealed packet165 binary
runtime.note: Measured packet165 identity, context 4096, BF16 KV; retained source/build evidence. Native benchmark only; no HTTP endpoint. Target-only, host-pinned experts and device cache.

project_patches.note: Own source runtime; no external runtime base or patch overlay.

text_measurements.scope: Each fresh load runs twelve cold suite prompts and one distinct 512-input-token prompt, with one user and a 4096-token context allocation. Decode is the class-balanced first-100-token generation rate across the twelve suite prompts. Each reading row measures one 512-input-token request on the warm runtime; native TTFT includes first-token work. One-card TTFT includes the request-state reset. The independent oracle covers only the first 128 output tokens; full-output quality remains pending.
